intro: Jugcraft has two great routes: machinery and magic. Each begins with things you can find in the world, so follow one, or both, in any order.
Pick a route for its milestones and chapters. This shows what this version of Jugcraft has.

routes.title: Machinery and Technology
summary: Machines build in stages, each needing parts from the ones before: bronze and your first power, the workshop's plates, wires and circuits, shafts and logistics, then steel, oil, chemistry and electronics.
Beside that road are specialties to take up when you like: ore processing, fluids, storage, farming, renewables and rocketry.
Each milestone opens the Engineer's Handbook at that stage; the chapters hold every machine's recipe and use.

routes.title: Magic: the Arcane Concordance
summary: The Arcane Concordance is research you earn by examining the world, and spells cast from your own Focus. It rises through five stages, Initiate to Architect, to a Concord Spire that changes the land round it.

Begin by sneaking and using something that glows: an amethyst shard, glow lichen or glow berries. Then take research in any order: cultivation, exploration and combat, and crafting and infrastructure each lead to a Spire.
The milestones and chapters open the codex, which shows each tradition's entries as you unlock them. Your Concordance Journal says what each step still needs.
